nodes.label: Internal Product Managers / Admins (Klarstein staff)
nodes.rationale: Primary users: high-frequency operational power users who value density, speed, and knowing exactly where every launch stands.

nodes.label: OriginFlow PLM Platform
nodes.rationale: Internal product launch/lifecycle platform coordinating a product from RFQ through development to production; success is a PM running many concurrent launches without losing the thread, optimizing for speed and clarity at scale.

nodes.label: The Control Room (Creative North Star)
nodes.rationale: The room a PM runs many launches from: calm dark navigation rail framing a bright uncluttered canvas; color spent almost entirely on state and the single accent; personality is calm, precise, trustworthy.

nodes.label: Anti-references (generic SaaS / consumer-flashy)
nodes.rationale: Rejects generic SaaS template scaffolding and consumer-flashy marketing aesthetics; density must always be ranked by hierarchy, never a gray wall of undifferentiated controls.

nodes.label: Brand Personality: Calm, Precise, Trustworthy
nodes.rationale: Earns trust the way good operational software does, by being predictable and honest about state, not by impressing; plain direct voice, restrained color.

nodes.label: Auth & Access Control
nodes.rationale: Auth context fetches Supabase session and profile; portal route detection bypasses PM bootstrap; ProtectedRoute blocks unauthenticated; AdminRoute restricts to role ADMIN.

nodes.label: portalClient (tokenized supplier client)
nodes.rationale: Second Supabase client used for public/tokenized supplier portal flows, separate from the authenticated PM/Admin client.

nodes.label: RLS & Token-Scoped Security Model
nodes.rationale: Security enforced primarily by RLS and tokenized portal flows; migrations evolve from broad authenticated policies toward PM-scoped access; permissive FOR ALL USING(true) public policies flagged as a hardening risk.

nodes.label: Supabase Backend (Postgres + Auth + RLS)
nodes.rationale: Supabase Postgres/Auth/RLS accessed via two JS clients: supabase for authenticated PM/Admin sessions and portalClient for public/tokenized supplier flows.

nodes.label: External Suppliers (factories/vendors)
nodes.rationale: Secondary users entering through token-based portals; occasional users in unfamiliar territory who need clarity and light guidance rather than density.

nodes.label: Karpathy Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Behavioral guidelines to reduce LLM coding mistakes: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, goal-driven execution with verifiable success criteria.

nodes.label: The Rail (fixed dark navigation)
nodes.rationale: Fixed 16rem dark rail (Control-Room Ink #1a1f35); active item = Action Steel fill; hidden below md and collapsed to top-bar affordance on mobile.

nodes.label: Compliance (TCF) Module
nodes.rationale: Category/feature/requirement library; compliance request creation and status workflow; supplier secure verification and response submission via security-definer RPCs.

nodes.label: Project Lifecycle Module
nodes.rationale: Project CRUD; auto-seeds launch steps and document templates at creation; milestone persistence; supplier token access via RPC.

nodes.label: Routing & App Shell (HashRouter)
nodes.rationale: HashRouter with public (login/portals/IM preview), protected PM, and admin routes; global providers for auth/toast/modal/error boundary; triggers compliance deadline check on mount.

nodes.label: Security-Definer RPC Functions
nodes.rationale: get_project_by_token_secure, get_projects_by_supplier_token, submit_production_update, get_compliance_request_secure, submit_compliance_response_secure validate token+code for portal writes.

nodes.label: Shared Infrastructure & UX
nodes.rationale: Notification center/polling, dashboard statistics service, error handling utilities, reusable hooks (useAsync/useForm/useDebounce), toasts, modal stack, error boundary.

nodes.label: Sourcing / RFQ Module
nodes.rationale: RFQ creation/retrieval; supplier invite entries via per-entry token; supplier quote submission and award flow; supplier proposals enhancement/conversion.

nodes.label: Supplier Module
nodes.rationale: Supplier CRUD; portal token retrieval; access-code regeneration; PM-supplier assignment model introduced in migrations.

nodes.label: Design Tokens (colors, spacing, radii)
nodes.rationale: Near-neutral palette (Control-Room Ink, Action Steel, semantic state hues), 4/8/16/24 spacing, radii sm 4 / md 8 / lg 12 / full.

nodes.label: Layered Elevation System
nodes.rationale: Layered not flat: rest -> sticky -> rail -> overlay; shadows are structural and paired with hairline borders; cards <=16px radius.

nodes.label: Inter-only Typography System
nodes.rationale: One well-tuned grotesque (Inter) doing everything; hierarchy from weight and size contrast; Headline/Title/Body/Label ramp; a UI with many labels reads calmer with one voice.

nodes.label: Steel Slate Accent (#3f5b73)
nodes.rationale: The one accent, reserved for action/selection/active state; a muted corporate blue-gray chosen over saturated indigo for a calmer feel; Tailwind indigo-*/blue-* scales remapped onto this steel ramp in index.html.

nodes.label: Impeccable Init Flow
nodes.rationale: Setup command that crawls the codebase once to write PRODUCT.md (strategic), DESIGN.md (visual, Google Stitch format), and .impeccable/live/config.json; every other impeccable command reads PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md first.

nodes.label: Impeccable Product Register
nodes.rationale: Guidance for when design SERVES the product (app UI, dashboards, tools); the product slop test is earned familiarity so the tool disappears into the task; one family, restrained color, all interactive states, modal-as-last-resort.

nodes.label: Impeccable Shape Reference
nodes.rationale: Produces a design brief through a discovery interview before any code; understand deeply first so implementation is precise; hands off to craft/freeform.

nodes.label: One-Voice Rule (Inter only)
nodes.rationale: No display serif, no second sans; if a screen feels like it needs a second typeface it needs better weight/size hierarchy instead.

nodes.label: State-Not-Decoration Rule
nodes.rationale: Saturated color is earned by meaning: it carries a status or marks action/selection, otherwise it is gray. No color placed for flavor.

nodes.label: OriginFlow Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Five principles: tool disappears into the task; status at a glance; trust through precision (no silent failure); density with hierarchy; guide the occasional user.

nodes.label: Impeccable Layout Reference
nodes.rationale: Space as a design material; 4pt spacing scale, flex for 1D / grid for 2D, container queries, squint test, break card-grid monotony; live-mode density param.

nodes.label: Impeccable Live Variant Mode
nodes.rationale: Interactive browser variant mode: pick an element, generate three within-identity variants via HMR, tunable parameters; identity-lock (Phase A) prevents off-brand drift; DESIGN.md wins on visuals, PRODUCT.md on voice.

nodes.label: Impeccable Onboard Reference
nodes.rationale: Get users to first value fast, not to teach everything; show-don't-tell, make it optional, empty states as onboarding, contextual tooltips.

nodes.label: Impeccable Optimize Reference
nodes.rationale: Performance is a feature; measure Core Web Vitals, fix the actual bottleneck, optimize images/JS/CSS/fonts, rendering and animation performance.

nodes.label: Impeccable Overdrive Reference
nodes.rationale: Push an interface past conventional limits using the full power of the browser; propose 2-3 directions before building, iterate with browser automation, progressive enhancement non-negotiable.

nodes.label: Impeccable Polish Reference
nodes.rationale: Final pass aligned to the design system (drift named by root cause); IA/flow shape, typography, color, all interaction states, edge cases; the shared handoff target of most other commands.

nodes.label: Impeccable Quieter Reference
nodes.rationale: Reduce visual intensity without losing personality; desaturate, add whitespace, reduce weight/motion; luxury not laziness.

nodes.label: Impeccable Typeset Reference
nodes.rationale: Replace generic defaults with intentional type; fixed rem scale for product UI, fluid clamp for brand; modular scale, weight roles, web-font loading, live-mode scale param.

nodes.label: Status Badges (signature four-hue vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Tinted pills in four families (steel/indigo, emerald, rose, gray) pairing hue with a text label; consistent status vocabulary used everywhere.

nodes.label: Accessibility Target WCAG 2.1 AA
nodes.rationale: Body text >=4.5:1, honor prefers-reduced-motion, never convey status by color alone, full keyboard operability.

nodes.label: Impeccable Harden Reference
nodes.rationale: Make designs production-ready against real inputs, errors, i18n, and network conditions; test extreme inputs, error scenarios, RTL/CJK, empty/loading/large-dataset states.

nodes.label: Impeccable Interaction Design Reference
nodes.rationale: The eight interactive states, focus-visible rings, native dialog/popover/anchor positioning, undo>confirm, roving tabindex, skip links.

nodes.label: Color-Plus-Shape Rule
nodes.rationale: Status is never conveyed by color alone; every status pill pairs hue with a text label so states are distinguishable without color vision.

nodes.label: Data Mapping Strategy (snake_case -> domain models)
nodes.rationale: Mapper utilities translate snake_case DB rows into frontend domain models.

nodes.label: Instruction Manual (IM) Module
nodes.rationale: IM templates by product category; hierarchical section model; multi-language content payloads; project IM instances with placeholder data and generation status.

nodes.label: Modular Service Layer (src/services/index.ts barrel)
nodes.rationale: Domain service folders are the single service layer imported via the barrel; legacy monolithic apiService.ts removed; shared query/mutation boilerplate centralized in src/services/core/db.ts (runMutation/runQuery).

nodes.label: Prepare Category Import Skill
nodes.rationale: Converts a raw category export into the two OriginFlow import files (attribute definitions then transposed SKU values); app parsers parseAttributeCsv and parseSkuCsv are the contract; feeds Admin Categories import and SKU Catalog bulk upload.
